assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Edit Image 1, the seated waist-up portrait. Image 2 is the approved SAME fictional man and supplies facial identity and his natural, emotionally withheld expression. Preserve Image 1's composition, clothing, chair, room, eye color and apparent age. Make a visible but anatomically natural correction to his head carriage, gaze and mouth.

SPECIFIC CHANGES TO IMAGE 1:
1. Straighten the lateral tilt of the head. Balance his head vertically above the neck and torso, with chin neutral and shoulders naturally settled. Keep the current amount of face rotation toward the viewer's right; do not turn him frontally or change the camera.
2. Remove the upward glance. Bring BOTH irises down from their present high position into a steady, level line of sight toward the unseen person ahead of him at his own eye height. The head and eyes attend in the same direction. Keep the original eye shape and normal eyelid opening. No sideways eye-roll, raised questioning brow, narrowed angry eyes or sleepy lids.
3. Restore the approved reference's natural resting lips. Remove the slightly pinched, pout-like, disapproving tension of Image 1. Keep the same lip shape, width and natural fullness, with barely perceptible resting separation like Image 2. Mouth corners are neutral, not lifted, pushed forward or downturned.
4. Let his upper torso sit a little more vertically while his back remains supported. Keep the shoulders open without spreading them wider. Forearms and hands rest on the chair naturally. The position is habitual and economical rather than a lounging fashion pose.

PERFORMANCE CONTEXT:
This is a man accustomed to giving short instructions and having them carried out. Capture the pause just after he has said something brief. He holds the other person's attention without soliciting agreement or displaying personal annoyance. Use the approved face's low emotional feedback: attentive eyes, quiet brow, unhurried mouth. Preserve inward tension and a guarded presence without making him coy, sulky, flirtatious, wounded, petulant, blank or theatrically intimidating. Do not make a new facial expression by exaggerating the brow.

PRESERVE:
The specific recognizable face of Image 2, youthful adult age, cheek and jaw proportions, continuous subtly angular chin with a natural hollow under the lower lip, short dark wavy hair, pale gray-blue irises, skin tone and natural texture. No face narrowing, longer chin, cleft, added age or new muscular bulk.
Retain Image 1's readable directional daylight and moderate contrast; do not darken the whole picture to suggest authority. Same black shirt, textured jacket, body scale, chair, framing and background. One photorealistic color image, original vertical 3:4 format. No other people, props, text or collage.
